blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro on Wednesday characterized as a “diversionary tactic” the defense’s manifestation claiming that a member of the prosecution had violated the impeachment court’s sub judice rule in Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial. On Tuesday, lead defense counsel Sheila Sison filed a manifestation flagging private prosecutors, particularly Atty. Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr., for supposedly violating the sub judice rule. “It seems like a diversionary tactic because the witnesses of the defense are not doing so well.
